Fortune-teller

Biography

The fortune-teller offers Kir predictions in return for money. She explicitly distinguishes what might happen from what must happen. Her riddling hints point toward local discoveries, including an orchard and a public building; the conversations present an optional chain of clues rather than an authoritative account of destiny. [1, 2, 3]
